title: The Man Who Bought a Talking Dog

lines.text: A man saw a sign. Talking dog for sale. Ten dollars.
The old owner pointed to the backyard.
Sure! I used to work for the CIA.
I caught spies in twelve countries.
Then I flew planes. Then I saved forty people from a fire.
Now I'm retired. I like the sun.
The man ran back to the owner.
That dog is amazing! Why only ten dollars?
He never did any of that.
